question: What functional unit does the life-cycle assessment of resource recovery from spent FCC catalysts use, and in what software and with what primary impact assessment method were impacts calculated?
rendered: The functional unit is the treatment of 1 t (1000 kg) of spent FCC catalyst. The life-cycle assessment was performed using SimaPro 10.1 software with the Environmental Footprint 3.1 (adapted) as the primary life-cycle impact assessment method.
